blocks.text: This holiday season, Waterfront Cebu City Hotel and Casino officially flipped the page revealing its most anticipated Christmas tree lighting celebration on November 5, 2026. With the theme, The Grand Christmas Library, the hotel celebrates the joy of reading, the power of storytelling, and the stories that bring people together. Inspired by the timeless magic of literature, the hotel grand lobby was transformed into a festive sanctuary of stories. The main highlight of the evening, a magnificent, towering Christmas tree adorned with holiday details and bookish decor, was officially lit, symbolizing warmth, hope, and togetherness for the Cebuano community.
